premise: Nico sits on his board waiting for the perfect wave: too small, too bumpy; the boats go by while he waits, and at last the just-right wave carries him all the way in.
inspiration: The Goldilocks three-tries pattern at sea: not this one, not that one, and the patience to wait for the one that is just right.
lesson: The right moment is worth waiting for.

en-US.title: The Perfect Wave
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s} {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico wanted to catch the perfect wave. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:go to sea by surf} He paddled out and sat on his board, waiting. Up and down. Up and down. A little wave came. {surfer:says} [playfully] "Too small." Another came. {surfer:says} "Too bumpy." {surfer:shake 0.4} [short pause] {sailboat:enter} The sailboat glided past, {sailboat:live} its sails puffing round and full. {fishing-boat:enter} The fishing boat chugged by, {fishing-boat:live} and hauled up its net. {surfer:says} [sad] "Where's MY wave?" {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Dog barked from far away, {dog:hop} as if to say: be patient. So Nico waited. And watched. And waited. [long pause] Then, far out, a wave began to rise, smooth and blue and just right. {surfer:glow 0.5} [excited] Nico stood up. {surfer:go to sand by surf} {sfx:wave} WHOOSH! He rode it all the way in, smooth as silk. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live} He waved his board at the boats. {surfer:says} [happily] "THAT was the perfect wave!" {dog:hop x2}

es-ES.title: La ola perfecta
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s} {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico quería coger la ola perfecta. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:go to sea by surf} Remó mar adentro y se sentó en su tabla, esperando. Arriba y abajo. Arriba y abajo. Llegó una ola pequeña. {surfer:says} [playfully] «Demasiado pequeña.» Llegó otra. {surfer:says} «Demasiado movida.» {surfer:shake 0.4} [short pause] {sailboat:enter} El velero pasó deslizándose, {sailboat:live} con las velas redondas y llenas. {fishing-boat:enter} La barca de pesca pasó haciendo chuc, chuc, {fishing-boat:live} y subió su red. {surfer:says} [sad] «¿Dónde está MI ola?» {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Perro ladró desde lejos, {dog:hop} como diciendo: ten paciencia. Así que Nico esperó. Y miró. Y esperó. [long pause] Entonces, a lo lejos, empezó a levantarse una ola, suave, azul y perfecta. {surfer:glow 0.5} [excited] Nico se puso de pie. {surfer:go to sand by surf} {sfx:wave} ¡FIUUU! La cabalgó hasta el final, suave como la seda. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live} Saludó a los barcos con la tabla. {surfer:says} [happily] «¡ESA sí que era la ola perfecta!» {dog:hop x2}
